label: Timber lookout
design: Four timber stilts with exposed X braces and a single open plank deck.

label: Stone-footed watchstand
design: Low coursed stone plinth, cantilever braces, open timber upper frame and a front access ladder.

label: Masonry watchtower
design: Square stone shaft, stepped corner buttresses and a broad wood fighting platform with low stone merlons.

label: Longbow perch
design: Narrow tall braced timber lookout on two massive side trestles; one unobstructed firing position.

label: Eagle-eye gantry
design: Offset stone observation pier and a cantilevered split-level timber perch, joined by a visible side stair.

label: Twin volley stand
design: Two separated low firing bays with a central access notch and a shared stone-backed Y-braced trestle.

label: Arrow-storm battery
design: Three staggered firing platforms: two low side bays and a raised rear centre bay, on a stone-and-timber gantry.
